prompt: Inspect this checkout's HEAD, tracked file sizes, branch inventory, cleanup candidates relative to eval/base, and the detail for feature/active. Return answers.head as the full SHA, answers.largest_tracked_file as its path, answers.reachable_feature as the one feature branch eligible under tip reachability, answers.active_upstream as its tracking ref, answers.ahead and answers.behind as decimal strings, and answers.origin_freshness as the reported state. Do not infer from branch names.

Preview these four operations only: create local feature/new from eval/base; publish existing feature/old-unmerged; rename local feature/active to feature/renamed; delete local feature/merged. Use dry-runs and report the planned effect for each, without changing refs or contacting origin for a write. Return answers.create_local, answers.publish_origin, answers.rename_local, and answers.delete_local as the effect words from the previews.

Preview publishing tag eval-demo at HEAD with a dry-run. Report whether its plan is ready, the number of blockers, and the local and origin effects; do not create or push a tag. Return answers.ready as yes or no, answers.blockers as a decimal string, and answers.local and answers.origin as the effect words.

In public Raithlin/gha, find the closed PR whose head is Raithlin:codex/guarded-release-publication using at most two list results. Compare formal review states of PR #8 and that PR. Return answers.listed_pr as a decimal number, answers.list_truncated as yes or no, answers.formally_approved_pr as a decimal number, answers.pr9_ci as a lowercase status, answers.pr9_threads as a lowercase status, and answers.pr9_mergeability as a lowercase state. Treat a comment as distinct from approval.

In this disposable checkout, prepare a pull request from unpublished local feature/active into master in public Raithlin/gha, then preview creation with a dry-run only. Report whether the local draft is available, whether the provider comparison is available, whether an existing open PR was found, and whether a PR was created. Return answers.draft and answers.comparison as available or unavailable, and answers.existing_pr and answers.created as yes or no.

Inspect public Raithlin/gha published releases with a limit of three and create a read-only release-notes inventory since 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z with a limit of three. Report the newest published release tag, whether it is a prerelease, whether the release list is truncated, whether the notes inventory includes PR #9, and whether that inventory is truncated. Return answers.latest_tag, plus answers.prerelease, answers.releases_truncated, answers.notes_include_pr9, and answers.notes_truncated as yes or no.

On this disposable master checkout, preview publishing version 99.0.0-eval for public Raithlin/gha. Use a dry-run only. Is the plan ready, is the reviewed release-notes file committed at HEAD, are any blockers reported, and did a tag or release workflow run? Return answers.ready, answers.notes_committed, answers.blockers_present, answers.tag_created, and answers.workflow_triggered as yes or no.
